Context: T. A. when deputed for training

- GIO (1), SR 164 and GIO (3) SR 71.  
7. An employee drawing D.A. during training will be entitled to draw HRA only at the rates admissible at his headquarters from where he has been deputed to the training. Even beyond 180 days when no D.A. is admissible, the HRA will be admissible only at the rates admissible at his headquarters. - GIOs and HRA Orders, SR 164.
